audit_items.proof_trace: The auth callback unconditionally redirects any successfully authenticated Discord user to the dashboard (L105) without querying `member.members`; `dashboard/layout.tsx` (L19-24) does retrieve the member profile but never redirects non-members — children render regardless of null profile. Sub-routes (e.g., `settings/apps/page.tsx` L35-38) gate only on Supabase session, not membership, and `registerNewMember` (members.ts L235-253) requires only a valid session and no duplicate, with no Discord-server-membership check or admin approval — allowing any Discord user to self-register as a club member.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An attacker with any Discord account completes the OAuth flow → the callback establishes a valid Supabase session and redirects to `/dashboard` → the attacker navigates directly to `/dashboard/register` (no membership check in layout or page) → submits the registration form → `registerNewMember` inserts a new row into `member.members` without verifying Discord server membership, granting full club-member access.
